## Houston 1.0.8

### What's new

- **A morning briefing from Houston.** Once a day, at the time you choose (8:00 by default), Houston checks on your team and writes a short briefing in its chat: what needs your attention, what got done, and what to do next. Set the time or turn it off in Settings > Morning briefing.
- **Org chart.** Admin > Org chart now opens on a chart of your company, with your people and AI Employees. Share turns it into an image and a ready-to-post LinkedIn message.
- **Clearer Channels settings.** Settings > Channels shows a connected Slack workspace as a card with its logo and a green Connected badge.

### Fixes and polish

- Houston can now open files you attach in its chat.
- When your workspace's allowed models hide every AI you connected, the model picker says so instead of asking you to connect one.
- Admin > Billing no longer appears on teams where billing isn't available.
- A message sent right as a chat opens no longer disappears from the screen.
- Sending right after the app wakes up no longer waits 15 seconds.
- A local model your workspace doesn't allow no longer shows an error every time the app starts.
- Routines and chats start faster for AI Employees with lots of files or long histories.
- Spaces with many AI Employees load without errors.
- Frosted panels blur properly in dark mode on Windows.
- The Slack "already connected" message now covers an account connected to another of your spaces.
- More reliability improvements under the hood.

### Before you upgrade

- Quit Houston before installing. macOS doesn't always replace a running app. If in doubt, delete Houston from Applications and drag the new copy in.
